SOCIAL
IMPACT
REPORT
2024
HOUSING WITH HEART

These achievements reflect our dedication to providing diverse housing solutions
that cater to the unique needs of individuals and families at risk of or experiencing
homelessness. We are especially proud to have provided homes for 15 people,
including women and their children, fleeing domestic abuse, supporting them on
their journey to a better life.
Our success is a testament to the dedication of our team, the generosity of our
donors, and the strength of our partnerships with charities, SDA providers, and
other stakeholders. We are deeply grateful for the collaborative spirit and shared
vision that fuels our work.
As we look towards 2025, we recognise the ongoing challenges of the housing crisis
in Australia. We are energised by the opportunity to make a tangible difference and
remain committed to strategically assessing the market to identify areas of greatest
need, acquiring and developing properties across all our programs, and securing
new funding opportunities to support our continued growth.
With your continued support, we are confident in our ability to continue reshaping
the concept of "home." We strive to provide not just safe and secure housing, but to
transform the way we, as a society, perceive and value the meaning of home.
Letter from the Board
Sincerely,
In 2024, the Sunrise Foundation experienced a period of significant growth and
positive change. We are immensely proud of the impact we have achieved in such
a short time, driven by our unwavering commitment to addressing homelessness
in Australia. Our mission is to provide a pathway to safe, stable, and affordable
housing, and in 2024, we made remarkable strides towards fulfilling this vision.
Key Achievements:
Community Housing Program: Our New South Wales Community Housing
Program successfully launched, providing Social, Transitional and Affordable
Housing pathways to those in need of assistance. We facilitated safe havens for
women and children escaping domestic abuse and saw essential workers and
families facing rental stress find affordable rental properties to call home.
SDA-Compliant Housing: We emerged as a recognised leader in SDA-compliant
housing, completing 8 dwellings and commencing construction on 83 more across
New South Wales, Victoria, and Western Australia. We look forward to expanding
the program further and providing more SDA-compliant housing throughout 2025
and beyond.
EquitiShare: Recognising that homeownership is a cornerstone of financial
security and a dream for many Australians, we introduced EquitiShare. This
innovative program is designed to bridge the gap between renting and owning,
making homeownership more accessible and affordable. By reducing the barriers
to entry, EquitiShare empowers individuals and families to achieve their
homeownership goals sooner, fostering long-term stability and societal wellbeing.
This initiative reflects our deep commitment to providing not just housing, but
creating pathways for individuals and families to build a brighter future.

About Sunrise Foundation
The Sunrise Foundation is a charitable organisation dedicated to
increasing the supply of affordable housing solutions in Australia.
Founded by property and finance expert Greg Huxley, the
Foundation was established in response to the urgent need for
affordable housing options across the country.
Through strategic partnerships and innovative programs, the
Sunrise Foundation has achieved significant progress in a short
period. Our innovative model combines charitable aims with
sustainable financial strategies, driven by a deep passion for
creating a brighter future for housing in Australia and a
commitment to making a lasting social impact.

The Community
Housing Program
Community housing programs play a vital role in providing safe
and affordable housing options for vulnerable populations. These
programs offer diverse housing solutions, including social housing,
transitional housing, and affordable housing, to meet the unique
needs of individuals and families facing homelessness or housing
insecurity.
By providing access to stable and affordable housing, community
housing programs empower individuals and families to rebuild
their lives, enhance their well-being, and achieve greater economic
security. These programs serve as a critical safety net, preventing
homelessness and breaking the cycle of poverty.
Our social and transitional housing program has launched in New
South Wales, with plans for expansion into Victoria soon. Our
affordable housing program operates in both New South Wales
and Victoria, experiencing strong demand with over 750
applications received for available apartments. We are committed
to expanding our property portfolio to continue serving this vital
sector.
11

SDA-Compliant Housing
Sunrise Foundation has extensive experience in SDA-compliant
housing. In 2024, we became a recognised industry leader,
overseeing the development and completion of compliant
dwellings, completing 8 certified builds for NDIS enrolment, with
another 83 underway.
EquitiShare
We have allocated a portion of our properties for sale to
Australians who face barriers to homeownership. Through
EquitiShare, we sell homes to eligible buyers while retaining a
partial interest of up to 20%, making the purchase more
affordable. New homeowners have the option to buy out our
share at any time, or we receive our share of the proceeds upon
the eventual sale of the property.
EquitiShare is a unique program, unlike any other in the market. It
is not vendor finance, so new homeowners do not carry the
burden of additional debt. It is a true equity partnership, with
Sunrise Foundation sharing in any depreciation with the
homeowner and gifting any property value increase over 10% to
the homeowner. As a charity with a clear purpose, we are
dedicated to providing a pathway to homeownership for everyday
Australians.
12

A Collaborative Approach
Our impact in 2024 is a direct result of successful collaborations
with various organisations, including charities offering safe refuge
and outreach services to domestic abuse survivors. We express
our gratitude to these charities for their invaluable expertise and
ongoing support for our social and transitional tenants.
We also extend our thanks to builders, SDA and SIL providers who
work alongside us to ensure residents are well-housed, as well as
our many other supporters, including key service provider
EquitiFund Group, our financiers, real estate agencies, donors,
staff, and countless others.
